bug_semantics: When parquet-avro reads a Parquet file using Avro SpecificData or ReflectData (not GenericData), AvroRecordConverter.getStringableClass honors attacker-controlled Avro schema properties java-class / java-key-class stored in file metadata, loads that class with ClassUtils.forName, and AvroConverters.FieldStringableConverter binds Class.getConstructor(String.class) then later ctor.newInstance(binary.toStringUsingUTF8()). A malicious Parquet file can therefore instantiate any classpath class with a String constructor. CVE-2025-30065's 1.15.1 package allowlist still defaulted org.apache.parquet.avro.SERIALIZABLE_PACKAGES to java.lang,java.math,java.io,java.net,org.apache.parquet.avro, so gadgets in those trusted packages remained executable; 1.15.2 empties that default (and adds parquet.avro.serializable.classes).
flaw_origin: The sink was first written in PARQUET-286 to match upstream Avro stringable/java-class behavior, with no package or class allowlist. Reconstructable PR #201 member 0e9240f5aa6fa3130d1453312540d94fd7736aa2 added FieldStringableConverter and getStringableClass; beb5a44b5530550afe4e628cb9b300146ca4e360 extended map-key/@Stringable coverage; asfgit squash 918609f2cc4e4de95445ce4fdd7dc952b9625017 landed the pair on master (first release apache-parquet-1.8.0). 1.15.1 8e70eea820d4d4b9d1ae240a9bc25d266ab780f3 is a later incomplete mitigation of that same sink, not the first write.

reasoning: CVE.org and the Apache vendor advisory confirm a real RCE in parquet-avro schema parsing for specific/reflect through 1.15.1; GHSA withdrawn_at is not authoritative and is null anyway. The mechanism is untrusted java-class names in Parquet-embedded Avro schemas driving reflective String-constructor instantiation in FieldStringableConverter. That code did not exist in PARQUET-243 (plain FieldStringConverter) and was first written in PARQUET-286. The asfgit landing 918609f2 is a named two-commit squash, so it is not the BIC; member 0e9240f5 is reconstructable, shares parent d6f082b9 with the squash, and those parent trees lack FieldStringableConverter/getStringableClass/JAVA_CLASS_PROP. beb5a44b only extends the same sink. Tag membership uses the squash that carried 0e9240f5 into releases: present from apache-parquet-1.8.0 through 1.15.1, matching affected-from-0 once that code existed. The 1.15.1 allowlist is an incomplete fix of this sink (default packages still gadget-capable), not a first write, and post-dates 1.15.0. 1.15.2 2fef79bb removes the default trusted packages, which is the advertised closure. AI is judged only on the BIC commit object: Ryan Blue in 2015, no AI trailers or bot identity on 0e9240f5 or the squash/members, so NOT_AI.
